_comment: Eggs on a belt: size by geometry, one verdict per egg at the decision line.
Select with EDGEFORGE_PROFILE=eggs. Layered over appsettings.json and under
Blob.MmPerPixel is the calibration and is specific to one camera position:
lay a ruler on the belt, measure how many pixels 100 mm spans, divide.
0.3333 matches samples/eggs.mp4 (960 px across 320 mm of belt).
Limits are checked against each egg's median over every frame it was seen
whole. Width is the short axis, the closest single proxy for weight class
a camera has - EU classes are by weight, so this is a size screen, not grading.
Blob.Threshold is fixed, not Otsu (0), on purpose. With a lit station the
belt and the eggs sit at known grey levels; Otsu re-picks the cut every
frame and lands high on a shaded egg, trimming its darker rim - measured
on samples/eggs.mp4 as ~0.8 mm undersize on every egg, enough to reject a
42.8 mm egg against a 42 mm limit. It also splits noise on an empty belt.
Set it halfway between belt and the darkest egg rim; 60 suits the sample.
RejectClasses only fire with a model trained on them (Detector.Kind=yolo and
Detector.ClassNames). The blob detector reports 'egg' only.
